lp_text: lp_text_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 CPLEX LP text produced by analytics/dispatch.py::to_cplex_lp for that vector (numbers formatted '%.10g', variables x0.., rows r0..; see dispatch_model.formulation for the order). The text itself is not stored per vector (about 30 KB each); rebuild it from dispatch_model.json (ba, day, params). Objective parity is the pass criterion; the hash is a diagnostic that fails first if the builder differs.
note: Rebuild the LP from dispatch_model.json (ba, day, params) in the browser and solve with HiGHS. Compare objective_usd, cost_breakdown_usd, unserved_mwh and co2_t within tolerance_rel (abs tolerance_abs for values near zero). price_usd_mwh is compared (tolerance_price_usd_mwh) only when expected.price_comparable is true, i.e. the balance duals were verified unique by finite differences; otherwise duals can differ between optimal vertices. class_energy_mwh, curtailed_mwh, soc_mwh and marginal_class are informative: zero-cost choices (hydro timing, curtailment split) can differ between optimal vertices. Vector kinds: preset, random (seeded interior control combinations), stress_unserved, stress_curtailment.
